FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnM.en: BILL files his own POKéMON data on\nhis PC.\pDid he show you?
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnM.fr: LÉO enregistre ses données sur les\nPOKéMON sur son PC !\pIl t'a déjà montré tout ça ?

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson.en: Hmm?\nYou've met BILL?\pHe's my grandson!\pHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson.fr: Hmm ? Tu connais LÉO ?\pC'est mon petit-fils !\pIl souffre de collectionnite depuis\ntout petit !

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFa.en: The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old, \nbut he's still very much active.\pAll his teeth are false, though.
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFa.fr: Le GARDIEN du PARC SAFARI est vieux\nmais trop cool !\pSes dents sont fausses par contre.

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanAsk.en: The WARDEN is so old and so tired.\nI make him soup but he needs\lmore than soup.\pTwo SUPER POTIONS for his old\nPOKéMON would do wonders.
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanAsk.fr:
Le GARDIEN est si vieux et si
fatigué. Je lui fais de la soupe\lmais il lui faut plus que de la
soupe.\pDeux SUPER POTIONS pour ses vieux
POKéMON feraient des merveilles.

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanGives.en: The WARDEN will cry, I know it.\pHe keeps this under his pillow.\nPlease, take it as thanks.
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanGives.fr: Le GARDIEN va pleurer, je le sais.\pIl garde ça sous son oreiller. S'il\nte plaît, prends-le en\lremerciement.

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanNo.en: I understand. It's a lot to ask of\na stranger.
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanNo.fr: Je comprends. C'est beaucoup\ndemander à un inconnu.

FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanOffer.en: SUPER POTIONS! Would you give two\nto the WARDEN's old POKéMON?
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WomanOffer.fr: Des SUPER POTIONS ! Donnerais-tu\ndeux aux vieux POKéMON du GARDIEN ?
